entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, the leader in personal fitness technology. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I have the order number if you need it.
Certainly, I can help with that. Please provide the order number when you're ready.
It's VF88602-P. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered about 30 days ago. Just for my records, what specifically is the issue with the band?
I just don't want it. Is it getting returned or not?
I understand. Generally, for a wearable device like this, it can be tricky. Due to hygiene and sanitation concerns, our new rules are quite strict. After 20 days, it's usually considered too late...
...but let me confirm the exact policy attached to your purchase. Please hold.
Okay, thank you for your patience. It looks like your order is actually covered by our older return policy. My system shows that you are eligible for a return within 10 days of delivery.
So, since you're only at day 30, I can definitely approve this for you. I've just processed the return.
Good. So you're sending a label?

Yes. A prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse processes it. Is there anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
